samir: Heads-up — kicking off a quick access checkpoint for the payments cluster. Doing a sweep for admin-entitlements and a KMS audit-log sanity check. Noticed a few gaps in the last 48h of KMS ingestion :thinking_face:
leah.eng: thanks. gap where? service-account logs missing or KMS key rotation events?
oscar-sre: saw the alert this morning from alerting (KMS_LOG_INGEST_FAIL). It looks scoped to region-eu-west-1 ingestion for the payments-keyring.
samir: exact—rotation events and grant changes around 2026-03-18 are sparse. trying to determine if it's delayed ingestion or missing telemetry. auditbot: automated note - KMS_LOG_INGEST_FAIL triggered 2026-03-18T08:12Z for payments-keyring (eu-west-1). Link: https://rbw-infra/alerts/8342 :rotating_light:
jamal-sec: can we quickly snapshot current admin principals before any prune so we have evidence? I can run the snapshot now.
samir: please do. prefer both a live IAM query and a KMS grant export. sample commands:
```bash
# list principals with admin role on payments cluster
gcloud iam roles describe roles/redwood.payments.admin --format=json || aws iam list-roles --query 'Roles[?contains(RoleName, `payments`)]'
# export KMS grants for payments keyring
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy payments-key --location=europe-west1 --format=json > payments-key-iam.json
```
leah.eng: also run the internal least-priv script - it flags broad roles and missing owners: `scripts/priv-check --scope payments --output=/tmp/payments-priv.csv`
oscar-sre: I'll pull Cloud Logging for the same window to correlate:
```bash
# logs proto (gcloud)
gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_key AND logName:compute.googleapis.com%2Factivity" --freshness=72h --format=json > kms-events.json
```
jamal-sec: snapshot done. storing on secure-s3: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/3589002468/snapshot-20260318.json :thumbsup:
leah.eng: thanks. next steps proposal:
- confirm ingestion delay vs missing logs (oscar)
- freeze any entitlement prunes until evidence stored (no ad-hoc changes)
- run least-priv recommendations, produce candidate prune list (jamal+samir)
- schedule short maintenance window for canary prune + 1hr rollback watch (ops)
- update ticket SEC-2026-217 with evidence links
